definitions.gloss: the second-in-command of a sports team or similar group, who assists the captain and takes over when the captain is absent
definitions.explanation: Formed by attaching the prefix {副|ふく}- (vice-, deputy-) to キャプテン (captain). Used mainly in sports teams — baseball, soccer, rugby, volleyball, and so on — as well as in school clubs and some student-government and youth-group contexts. The {副|ふく}キャプテン is chosen to support the captain in leading the team and to step in as acting captain when the captain is absent or unable to play.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はサッカー{部|ぶ}の{副|ふく}キャプテンだ。
examples.english: He is the vice-captain of the soccer club.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}から{副|ふく}キャプテンを{務|つと}めることになった。
examples.english: I have been made vice-captain starting this year.

examples.japanese: キャプテンが{欠場|けつじょう}したので、{副|ふく}キャプテンがチームをまとめた。
examples.english: Because the captain was out, the vice-captain held the team together.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{三年生|さんねんせい}になってバスケットボール{部|ぶ}の{副|ふく}キャプテンに{選|えら}ばれ、{後輩|こうはい}の{面倒|めんどう}をよく{見|み}ている。
examples.english: In her third year she was chosen as vice-captain of the basketball club, and she takes good care of the younger members.

notes:
Compound of the prefix {副|ふく}- (vice-, deputy-, assistant-) + the loanword キャプテン (captain). The {副|ふく}- prefix is attached to many role and title words to indicate a second-in-command position.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {副|ふく}キャプテンを{務|つと}める: to serve as vice-captain
- {副|ふく}キャプテンに{選|えら}ばれる: to be chosen as vice-captain
- {副|ふく}キャプテンに{任命|にんめい}する: to appoint as vice-captain
- チームの{副|ふく}キャプテン: the team's vice-captain

RELATED ROLE TERMS:
- キャプテン: captain (of a sports team or group)
- {主将|しゅしょう}: team captain — the traditional Sino-Japanese equivalent of キャプテン, common in written sports coverage.
- {副|ふく}{主将|ふくしゅしょう}: vice-captain — the Sino-Japanese equivalent of {副|ふく}キャプテン; used interchangeably in many contexts.
- {副|ふく}{部長|ぶちょう}: vice-president of a club (more administrative than team-oriented)

REGISTER:
Neutral. {副|ふく}キャプテン is common in everyday conversation, school-club contexts, and the popular press, while {副|ふく}{主将|しゅしょう} tends to appear in more formal sports reporting and official team rosters.

THE PREFIX {副|ふく}-:
The same prefix yields a wide set of "vice-" or "deputy" titles:
- {副社長|ふくしゃちょう}: vice president (of a company)
- {副会長|ふくかいちょう}: vice chairperson
- {副大統領|ふくだいとうりょう}: vice president (of a country)
- {副校長|ふくこうちょう}: vice principal
